messages.content: Before the block expires, compare it one more time with Downtown East. I need true lodging totals, when each charges me, the cancellation cutoffs, Saturday bag storage, and how many rides each plan requires.

The summit block is $478.10 for the room and tax plus a $25 urban fee each night, totaling $528.10. Friday breakfast is included. It is guaranteed by card today but not charged until checkout on August 23. You can cancel without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Central on August 19; after that, the penalty is one night including tax and fee.

Downtown East is $389.28 prepaid for the two nights. Adding its $24 Friday breakfast makes the comparable lodging total $413.28. The $389.28 is charged when reserved and is nonrefundable; breakfast is paid at the hotel.
Now put those against the ticketed flight cost and include transportation. How many separate rides are you assuming?

With the $407 airfare and checked-bag estimate, Downtown East comes to $952.28: $407 flights, $413.28 lodging and breakfast, and $132 for eight rides. That leaves $97.72 of the $1,050 allowance.

The block comes to $1,021.10: $407 flights, $528.10 lodging, and $86 for two airport rides. It leaves $28.90. The block costs $68.82 more overall, but the summit and Saturday roundtable are walkable.
And both will actually hold my suitcase after checkout Saturday? I don't want that based on an assumption.

Yes. Both front desks confirmed complimentary luggage storage after Saturday checkout for a registered guest, with pickup later that afternoon. Downtown East would still require rides to and from the roundtable; at the block hotel, you can leave the bag at the desk and walk back for it before heading to the airport.
Reserve the block, then. The fewer moving pieces Saturday are worth the difference, and it still stays under the allowance.

I can place the two-night reservation for August 21-23 using the card on file. Please confirm that I should accept the $528.10 total, the August 19 at 6:00 p.m. Central cancellation deadline, and payment at checkout.
Confirmed. Use the card on file and complete it.

The summit block is reserved for August 21-23 at $528.10 total. The card guarantees the room; payment is due at checkout on August 23. Cancellation is free through 6:00 p.m. Central on August 19, after which a one-night penalty applies. Saturday luggage storage is confirmed. With flights, the checked-bag estimate, and two airport rides, the complete trip is projected at $1,021.10, leaving $28.90 of the allowance.
